english.title: Display of invalid food hygiene rating sticker by operator of a food business - Wales
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the operator of a food business establishment, namely **(..SPECIFY ESTABLISHMENT..), without reasonable excuse displayed a food hygiene rating sticker which was invalid in that **(..SPECIFY HOW STICKER WAS INVALID..)
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 9(1)(b) and 20 of the Food Hygiene (Rating) Wales Act 2013.

Summary: a fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale. Fixed penalty notice - two hundred pounds, reduced to one hundred and fifty pounds if paid within 14 days of issue of notice.

6 months
